steps.title: Multi-factor combination lab loads
steps.narration: The combination lab lets you compose any two-factor pair and see instantly whether it has been referee-certified out-of-sample. With the default selection — relative-strength leaders paired with ATR volatility — the composite cohort row honestly reads 'Not yet proven'.
steps.point_out: The muted 'Not yet proven' badge on the composite cohort row at the bottom of the table — no link attached, because this combination has not cleared the referee.

steps.title: Select the certified pair — badge flips to Proven
steps.narration: Change the second leg to the factor certified by the referee — stocks that are near their 52-week high — and the badge reacts immediately without a page reload, switching to an accent-colored 'Proven' chip with a ShieldCheck icon and a deep link to its evidence row.
steps.point_out: The accent 'Proven' badge with ShieldCheck icon on the composite row — it is now a clickable link pointing directly to the combination's evidence entry.

steps.title: Evidence page — sixth certified claim row
steps.narration: The Evidence page now lists six referee-certified claims. The newest entry is the rs_spy_3m × high_proximity combination at the 20-day horizon: a PASS verdict, +4.69% holdout edge beating SPY out-of-sample, registration date 2026-07-01, and a 'Backs: Multi-factor combination lab →' linkback.
steps.point_out: The sixth row at the bottom — two condition chips, a PASS badge, the +4.69% holdout edge figure, and the linkback to the combination lab.

steps.title: Navigate back to the lab via the evidence linkback
steps.narration: Every evidence row carries a link back to the research tool that produced it. Clicking 'Backs: Multi-factor combination lab →' returns you to the combination lab, completing the round-trip between exploration and proof.
steps.point_out: The combination lab reloads — navigation flows naturally in both directions between the lab and the evidence ledger.

steps.title: Swap to an uncertified pair — badge reverts honestly
steps.narration: Switch back to the ATR-volatility second leg and the badge immediately returns to 'Not yet proven' with no link — only the one pre-registered combination that survived the referee earns the 'Proven' status; every other composition is shown as uncertified.
steps.point_out: The muted 'Not yet proven' badge reappears on the composite row — no link, no accent color, no ShieldCheck icon.

steps.title: Stocks page — no combination badge leakage
steps.narration: The combination claim is signal-less by design and stays off the per-stock cards. Only the certified Leadership Score continues to light the 'Proven' inline badge on each stock — no combination or composite badge has appeared anywhere in the stocks list.
steps.point_out: The Leadership Score 'Proven' badge on each stock card, unchanged — no combination badge present anywhere on the page.
